preconditions: Separate explicit authorization for hosted execution; this file grants none.
Identify protected hosted runtime and its verified project/team/Preview identity through provider metadata, not caller-supplied environment claims.
Use the saved successful hosted verifier evidence. Its single-use guard is consumed. Never execute the verifier again.
Verify immutable deployment belongs to exact staging project, uses derived candidate, excludes local fixture build and has deployment protection.
Select existing approved synthetic staging product/category; abort if data provenance is unverified, absent or contains production/customer data. Do not create test data.
Refresh safe environment metadata and public-key binding immediately before execution.
Accepted narrow SEO-only scope: SMTP sink is not a requirement; no email/auth workflows or direct provider API testing. Preserve disabled Auth settings.

Authenticated browser must use a fresh context with serviceWorkers blocked and routing registered before first navigation. Permit only GET/HEAD to the immutable staging deployment; deny all other origins, methods and WebSockets. No protection bypass secret in files, URLs or chat.
Do not loosen deployment protection to run the optional unauthenticated HTTP harness. Use a reviewed protected browser session instead; a 401/redirect is a failed precondition.

networkPolicy.note: Browser routing must block side effects before navigation. Inspect any additional read dependency before adding it. The separate verifier has its own single fixed privileged Auth GET and is not covered by this acceptance allowlist.

assertions: Settings and promotions reads succeed against staging
No suppressed loader errors or broad fallback
No staging/private URLs in sitemap content
robots.txt Disallow: /; all responses X-Robots-Tag noindex, nofollow, noarchive
Validate each sitemap shard without navigating to its production loc URLs
Production canonical URLs are inspected as strings, never fetched
Never submit a POST to the hosted environment; mutation checks remain synthetic-only
Homepage, Boutique, category and product hydrate without page errors
No successful non-read, external-origin or WebSocket requests
All displayed assets must be local; remote production/CDN assets remain blocked
All 30 repaired image hashes match; inspect Product JSON-LD and expected staging data
Do not claim Google indexing or rich-results outcomes from a noindex Preview

evidence: Pass/fail and HTTP status per route
Allowed/blocked network counts without headers or queries
No secret values, credential fingerprints, account response bodies or session cookies

cartDisplay.reason: Current candidate blocks /panier/; do not broaden scope or submit checkout.
